I graded `submissions/s2.json` and wrote `grades/0001-s2.json`: 3 correct, 2 partial, 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | Correct | The model only writes the tool request, and the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | Wrong (M6) | You chose "no change; it will eventually fix the bug". An agent that gets the same failing result 40 times learns nothing new, so it needs a step limit enforced by the program. Each extra step also costs money. |
| q4 | Partial (M4) | Your answer of 4 is right. Your reasoning says the model "runs" the tools itself, but the model only requests them and the program runs them. |
| q5 | Correct | You gave both parts: the result goes back in as the next input, so the model can decide its next step. |
| q6 | Partial | The name is only part of it. The model chooses a tool from the whole description: name, purpose and parameters. |

**What to work on:** the model asks and the program acts, and an agent needs a stopping condition. Trace the laser cutter request again on paper and label each step "model writes" or "program does". Add a step limit. Then write a full description for `check_calendar`.

I also added learning record `0003-model-asks-program-runs.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. `submissions/s1.json` is still ungraded. Do you want me to grade it so we can compare the two attempts?
